Package org.jlab.coda.emu.support.codaComponent

Enum Class CODACommand

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<CODACommand>
org.jlab.coda.emu.support.codaComponent.CODACommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<CODACommand>, Constable
public enum CODACommand extends Enum<CODACommand>
This class enumerates all the commands that Run Control can send to this Emu. These objects only contain static data.
